text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — elevated 5xx rate + cross-region routing deviation detected for /v1/generate. 5xx ~15% over last 5m, p50 latency spiked 120ms -> 850ms. Affected: requests originating in eu-west2 being routed to us-east1. Runbook: /runbooks/crossregion-route-deviation. P2. Please ack and follow on-call steps.

maya: ack — I'm gathering traces and traceroutes from eu-west2.

ben: on-call here, taking lead. can someone check active steering policy and recent promos? carla?

carla: looking. routing-policy 'geo-prefer-v2' shows an automated fallback rule that matched eu-west2 due to a stale probe metric (latency_eu=stale). I can stage a policy change to prefer-local for eu-west2 but want a quick rollback plan.

dave: traceroutes from affected hosts show paths terminating in us-east1. DNS TTLs are normal (~60s). telemetry shows steering weights for eu-west2 dropped to 0.15 and us-east1 jumped to 0.8 at ~1767549800. investigating control-plane publish.

erin: any confirmed customer impact? CS getting alerts.

frank: WidgetCorp (enterprise) reports ~50% failures on generate endpoint since ~10:10 UTC. They're impacted and asking for ETA.

carla: preparing canary patch. plan: (1) refresh probes for eu-west2 agents (2) stage canary that increases eu-west2 weight to 0.8 for local-pref (3) monitor 5xx and latency then promote. command I'm going to run:
```bash
./ops/routectl promote --policy geo-prefer-v2 --region eu-west2 --weight 0.8 --canary
```
Rollback: ./ops/routectl promote --policy geo-prefer-v2 --region eu-west2 --weight 0.2 --canary

ben: do the probe refresh first, then canary. I'll watch SLOs and error budget.

maya: running probe refresh (agent-refresh job) now.

carla: probe-refresh command: `kubectl -n infra exec -it probe-refresh -- /usr/local/bin/refresh_probes --region eu-west2`

incident-bot: probe-refresh job started (job/id=job-7832).

dave: pushed probe refresh patch to eu-west2 agents. waiting 45s for new health to reflect.

incident-bot: probe-refresh succeeded, probe health -> green.

carla: starting canary promote now: `./ops/routectl promote --policy geo-prefer-v2 --region eu-west2 --weight 0.8 --canary`

ben: canary in progress. watching 5xx and p95.

maya: preliminary metrics: 5xx dropping from 15% -> 4% within 2m of canary. p95 latency trending down.

erin: updating status page: "degraded — request routing anomalies causing errors for some EU customers. Investigating." adding note for WidgetCorp contact.

frank: WidgetCorp notified about mitigation step and suggested client-side retry header. they asked for credit; CS will follow up after stabilization.

liu: I'm next on-call in ~20m; if you need escalation ping me.

ben: promoting to full roll now (no longer canary) — `./ops/routectl promote --policy geo-prefer-v2 --region eu-west2 --weight 0.95`

incident-bot: policy promotion executed (tx=tx-4421).

maya: post-promotion metrics: 5xx at 0.9%, p95 back to ~140ms. customer error reports decreasing.

carla: root cause likely: stale probe state caused fallback rule to pick a us-east1 fallback with higher weight; follow-up: make probe health transitions more conservative and add verification before automated fallback. Filing follow-up ticket INF-4823.

ben: marking incident mitigated. keeping monitoring for 30m. I'll hand off notes to liu and create postmortem outline.

liu: acked, I'll take post-incident ownership and schedule the follow-up. please add links to traces and the routectl transaction log.

maya: leaving traces and a short timeline in the ticket: links -> https://tracing.redwood.ai/trace/tx-4421 and logs -> https://logs.redwood.ai/q/tx-4421.

incident-bot: Incident state: MITIGATED. Current 5xx=0.8% over 5m. Auto-close candidate in 2h if metrics remain stable.

ben: final notes — affected customers: WidgetCorp + BetaApps; mitigation: probe refresh + routing policy promote; follow-ups: INF-4823 (probe->fallback race), add integration test for policy promotion, and improve CS notification automation. Closing thread after handoff.
